reviews.text:
We’ve been working with Sara in private sessions with our sweet, fluffy 15-year-old senior dog, Cupcake. Our goal was to explore ways to make her life more enjoyable, reduce her anxiety, and help her communicate with us more peacefully instead of through coughing or anxious demands.

Sara has been wonderful at tailoring every session specifically to Cupcake and to us. She teaches us how to observe her more closely, understand what she is communicating, and respond in ways that make her feel enriched and more understood. After every session, my partner and I come away with a new understanding of Cupcake, and it has genuinely changed the way we relate to her.

We used to think that because Cupcake is already 15, there might not be much new for her to learn or for us to explore together. Sara completely changed that perspective. Watching Cupcake interact with us differently, noticing little things we had overlooked before, and continuing to learn about her has brought so much new joy into our relationship with her.

One thing I especially appreciate is the way Sara talks about and treats Cupcake as a student who is still full of potential. As parents of a senior dog, that has been incredibly encouraging and touching. She helps us see Cupcake not simply as an old dog who needs care, but as a curious, capable little being who can still learn, communicate, and experience new things.

Sara also sends thoughtful notes after each session with what we discussed, recommendations, and useful resources. We’ve actually implemented many of her suggestions at home, and they’ve become such a helpful part of caring for Cupcake.

Thank you so much, Sara. We hope to keep learning from you, become better dog parents, and make Cupcake’s senior years as joyful and fulfilling as possible. Your support has made a real difference to our whole family, including Cupcake. ❤️

Highly recommend Sara and the Raintown Dog Training team!
Thank you so much for the 5 stars, Eric! - Kris

Definitely recommend to new dog owners! The tools we've learned from Basic Manners 1 & 2 are helping us navigate our dog through his teenhood. The trainers are also so enthusiastic, knowledgeable, and patient.

Mochi definately built his confidence through Sarah and Dana’s guidance. We did one puppy socialization and kindergarten. The first time at puppy socialization Mochi was hiding under the chair and did not come out at all. It’s a huge progress after the end he was out there with the other pups 🥰

He now graduated learning sit, down, stay, touch/come, leash waking.

They were always there to answer extra questions as well and was very welcoming towards everyone.

Thankyou!!

60 minute class 40 minutes of oration. No refunds and no transferring my 5 remaining classes to my puppy owning friend.
I guess the logo is “We’re not happy til your not happy.”
Oh and our new puppy choked on plastic bits from the snuffle mat.
Caveat emptor.

We brought our 13 week  puppy for Raintown's Puppy Socializing sessions and had a great experience. The training staff are very attuned to the temperaments of the various pups and group the dogs accordingly. This type of socialization is so important at a puppy's life stage and will help contribute to a well-mannered adult dog in the future.

We signed up for puppy kindergarten for our puppy Apollo. Dana and Sara were so kind, patient, and helpful, and always happy to answer our questions.

We can tell Apollo enjoyed every class. It was a great place for him to socialise with other puppies before he got all vaccination, would definitely recommend them😊

We also have already signed up for the basic training class!
Thanks so much for taking the time to give us a great review, Marieke! We hope to see you soon. 😊 - Kris …

the absolute best place to go to get your puppy socialized early. our pup, melly, loves the puppy socials! we were nervous about how to get our girl socialized in a safe environment. we took a chance on raintown’s puppy socials, and were beyond impressed! they provided a great space for the puppies to engage in safe play, with trainers who are always on the lookout to intervene (and give advice) if anything gets too problematic. melly will miss these play sessions once she hits 21 weeks! super glad we found them early :)

This was the best start I could have asked for with my puppy. I came to Raintown on a friend’s recommendation, and it exceeded my expectations.

Kris and Dana created such a positive, welcoming environment and really understood how to work with shy puppies like Toshka. They never rushed him and always celebrated the little wins!

The weekly lessons helped build not only Toshka’s confidence, but my confidence as a new puppy owner too. They truly know what they are doing and go above and beyond to make every puppy feel successful. Whether it’s the puppy classes or the puppy socials, every question I had was answered, and I always left feeling more confident and better prepared. Thank you for everything!

Great tips for dog training and
very knowledgeable instructors

There are so many reasons why this dog school has so many five star reviews!!! Believe them all! They are absolutely wonderful and know everything about their specialty - all things dogs! They have been so good with our puppy Tilly in her socialization classes. They are super positive and informative, and they make sure that we know what to do with Tilly at all times. We are currently at another dog school as well, in a different city, but we travel 30-40min to their location in Vancouver just to do their classes. Bernadette and Sarah are wonderful people, beyond knowledgable, and are so kind to us and Tilly (unlike this other school). If you are hesitating on whether to join this school, DON’T. They are great people and their facility is set up so well for different types of dogs (not to mention, super clean too!). Thanks Sarah and Bernadette! We appreciate you both!

We did the Basic Manners Class with Bern and Sara and learned so much!!! Thank you for creating such a welcoming, thoughtful and fun place for us and our pup to learn. We feel much better equipped with new skills and strategies!

Our pup just finished Kindergarten with Bern. She was amazing. All instructions were clear and she was always up to answer questions and help us brainstorm some specific at home training strategies. Very kind and friendly environment. Would definitely recommend.

We had an amazing experience with Raintown dog training and would highly recommend them to any pup owner. Our puppy, Casper, attended several puppy socials as well as the 5 week training course and he absolutely loved every minute of it. Honestly so did we. Trainer was knowledgeable, patient and helping both puppies and their owners succeed. The skills and commands we learned during the course have become part of our daily routine and we still practice them regularly. 🐾

We took our puppy to both the Puppy Preschool course and Kindergarten at Raintown Dog Training, and it has been an incredible experience. The entire staff is friendly, attentive, personable, and completely non-judgmental. They truly take the time to get to know you and your puppy as individuals.
​Through their classes, I’ve learned so much about how to be a supportive dog parent and how to stay actively engaged with my pup. We’ve built an amazing foundation of trust with the team here. Their puppy socials are also fantastic and have been great for us. We will absolutely be doing more training and education with them in the future.

Meadow had the best time at Raintown! Sara and Bernadette were equally knowledgeable and engaging 🤎 They lead with positivity and always explain the why behind the what. We will definitely be back for Basic Manners II and would recommend Raintown to anyone looking for puppy training 🐾 …

We tried a couple dog schools in Vancouver and Raintown is by far our favourite. Their puppy socials and puppy kindergarten helped our shy pup gain her confidence and come out of her shell. We just finished Basic Manners 1 with Bern and it was fun, approachable, and very useful (the emergency recall they teach is a godsend). Bern is an excellent trainer! She is warm and knowledgeable and our pup loves her :)

Bern and Sara were awesome! The class was really fun, I feel like we’ve learned a lot and I think if you are wondering if you should put your puppy or dog in some classes. Raintown is the place to go.

the best experience I’ve ever had! I have a shy shy and lowkey angry chihuahua and have been struggling with her reactivity (we are moving to a bigger city) and I am so glad I met Bern! Classes felt educational for both myself and my pup, and they’re extremely understanding of all situations. Truly pet owner AND pet focused, if you have any behavioral questions or really any questions at all about why your dog might be doing something, this is the place to go and the people to work with!

I had such a great experience with Kris and Raintown, I can't recommend them enough! I reached out about my Frenchie who had a long running behavioural issue. He has a very unique resource guarding pattern that was cyclical. I had used other trainers but hadn't quite gotten on top of it, and I needed a different approach and Raintown delivered.

Kris and the team spent the time to understand the quirks, and put together a meticulous plan with various stages of progression.

I have already seen a marked improvement in his behaviour. I'm now able to prepare his food without having to put him in a different room, and I can bring him into the office and know I can get him off the couch without a meltdown. I'm forever grateful to Kris and the team!!

If you're looking for experienced trainers who know their stuff and can handle all sorts of dogs, you've found them.

We recently completed the puppy kindergarten class with our Shetland Sheepdog and we think its an absolute must for pet parents (even the experienced ones!) Our trainer Dana was excellent, and the socialization time provided every session really helped our shy guy come out of his shell and learn to enjoy other dogs. 10/10 Would recommend!

Kris is amazing with dogs, and has an especial gift for reactive dogs and puppies. She never uses force-based methods, instead she uses her extensive training in dog behaviour to come up with a plan that works with how your dog naturally behaves. In this case, she really helped out with a resource guarding Frenchie who gets triggered by hanger and too many people he likes being in the same space! She came up with an amazing step-by-step plan based on his specific triggers and guarding motivations, and checked in regularly with us to see how it was going. Each stage of the plan was updated based on the effects of the stage before. I cannot recommend her enough, especially for anyone whose dog is a bit of a weirdo and has unusual resource guarding issues!

My puppy has recently completed Pre School and Kindergarten courses both taught by Kris and Dana. There is a big focus on socializing with other puppies and you learn valuable tool/skill each class as well. It has made life so much easier having a happy, confident dog. I can not recommend them enough. Money well spent. Oh and don’t sleep on the puppy socials, they are as much fun for the parents as they are the puppies !

I absolutely cannot recommend Raintown enough. We have a really complex dog who is a verified good girl, absolutely fine with full body touch, non reactive, but is terrified of having her face groomed.  She was so fearful that she would try to bite, which is totally out of character for her in all other circumstances and was honestly heartbreaking to see.  She is a non-shedding curly haired girlie, so grooming is non-optional for her health and overall care.  Things got to the point where the groomer could not physically touch her, even without tools, and we turned to Bernadette at Raintown for help.

We did private sessions and then continued with the training plan on our own and, fast forward to 6 months later, our girl just had her first full grooming ever!!  She tolerated the process without even trying to bite.  I broke down in tears when we picked her up because I had been at the point where I felt like she would need to have sedated grooms at the vet for her whole life (hello, expensive and possible anesthesia complications 4x per year...). Seeing her grow in this way has been incredible.  She's honestly a completely different dog to what she was before we did those private sessions. She’s so much more confident in all areas of life and she trusts us even more than she used to. Bernadette's help has literally changed everything for us, in the best way possible.  She was so encouraging and thoughtful in the way she worked with us and our pup.  She met us where we were with compassion, and really helped us feel confident and well supported in how to help our dog progress.

Everyone at Raintown is amazing so I would totally recommend ANY of them, but Bernadette will always have a special place in our hearts.  Thank you, thank you, thank you!!
Our mini dachshunds just graduated Basic Manners 1. A big thank you to Bern and Sara for their patience and expertise. We look forward to Basic Manners 2!
Our dog had a great time learning his basic manners with Bern. Highly recommend to anyone looking to socialise and train their dog more!
Such a lovely and helpful group! The trainers are so patient, understanding, and experienced. They make sessions fun and not-at-all overwhelming or intimidating. Highly recommend!!

Do you want A+ puppy training accompanied by wit, humour and human connection? Then look no further - Raintown is the place to go! My puppy attended both preschool and kindergarten, taught by Kris and Dana, and it was the perfect blend of instruction, socialization and valuable advice. I watched my puppy go from timid and wayward, to confident and obedient in such a short time. I'm not sure who came out better educated - my pup or me. The things I learned will continue to influence how I work with my dog, and any dog I have in future. Now that we've graduated (with distinction - ahem!) my only sadness is I won't see Kris and Dana once a week anymore. They are fantastic!

Highly recommend attending the Puppy Kindergarten class! I wasn’t sure what to expect as this was my first time with a puppy but Dana and Kris were so welcoming! They were so helpful and provided a lot of useful knowledge on training and learning about differences in puppy behaviour.

I didn't sign up for classes but I took my dog to the puppy socials and they were really great for getting her socialized and set her up well for being around other dogs during adolescence. The raintown crew are really nice and I would recommend them even though I didn't do the classes. The puppy socials are a great idea and I also signed up for the dog walking service. It's nice they offer so many services.

I did find it a tiny bit frustrating that they kept weaving lectures into the puppy socials as I found it a little condescending and would prefer the entire 30 minutes be used as playtime as not everyone who is taking their dog to a social has zero experience with training. But this is just some minor feedback and overall I still found the experience to be pleasant and valuable.

We love Raintown! Cant recommend them highly enough. We brought our pup, Fyvie, to Raintown for preschool, kindergarten and several drop in socials. Before we even put the car in park she was losing it in the back seat, she couldn’t wait to get inside to see her friends and her favorite trainers. As her mums we learned just as much as she did and we are still using those lessons and skills to help her adapt to the big world. You won’t regret signing up for any of their classes!
Amazing people and location. Trainers were wonderful in catering to the individual needs of each puppy! Very good at filling in the gaps if your dog training knowledge.

I did the Basic Manners course with my five-year-old rescue and Bern was awesome. She handled the dynamic between a bunch of puppies/young dogs and my dog so well, and I learned a lot. If you’re prepared to do the homework, this class gives you a very good foundation to work from.

We are so grateful to the Raintown crew for helping to build our dog Cosy’s confidence, and also ours! We learned so many wonderful things, but one of the biggest takeaways was how possible Bern and Sara made things feel, and how genuinely they cared about all of our success. Thank you Raintown! Wish we could go every week 😭 …
Loved it!!!

We had such a great experience with Bern at Raintown! Our shepherd pup learned basic manners for going to place, recall, and friendly greetings.  The environment and instruction was super positive for all the dogs in the group and we enjoyed every class of the 5 week session. I would definitely recommend Raintown to other new pup owners and we are looking forward to doing the next level of classes!

I took my puppy here for puppy preschool and kindergarten and it was such a great experience! The instructors, Kris and Dana, were knowledgeable, kind, and incredibly helpful. My puppy has grown so much in her classes at Raintown and we love taking her here!

Edit for the response:
The reviews will show that the "reviews" are unverified - meaning they can't track reviews to an actual purchase. If you know the right people and the right places to research.. one  owner still attached is not good business. Good enough to get "reviews" posted. Also doesn't cost much to pay for reviews. There is also another brand called One Paw. Which might also saturate your research.

The Instagram for this company showcased a brand and mentioned a high rated harness "made by" the company "in Vancouver"
Both being lies. Please look into who you promote. Because that company is not one to be recommended.
Thanks so much for this rating, Scott! - Kris
Our puppy had so much fun in the kindergarten classes! Bern, Rhiannon, and Dana were all so kind and knowledgeable. I would definitely recommend Raintown for new puppy owners.
We’ve had a great experience with the team at raintown! They are super knowledgable and great trainers.  Excited to sign up for the next set of classes. Highly reccomend!

We had such a great experience coming to puppy kindergarten as well as puppy socials. Toast started out very timid and scared and came out of her shell so fast with attending. We all learned a lot and are looking forward to basic manners class. The trainers are fantastic! Thank you

My husband and I completed the Puppy Kindergarten course with our golden retriever puppy.

We had an excellent experience with Raintown Dog Training, particularly with our instructors/trainers, Sara & Dana. They both did an excellent job guiding us through the course, and providing helpful suggestions based on our pup's progress. Couldn't recommend these two trainers more - THANK YOU!

I had 3 private sessions with Kris, and she was a wealth of information. The stress of living with a reactive dog has not disappeared, but I've learned some great tools and have already felt like my dog and I have made great progress in this short time. I will definitely be coming back for some more lessons in the future.

We started out at Raintown with Puppy Kindergarten and Basic Manners, both of which were immensely helpful at setting us up for success as first time puppy owners. We've since participated in their community walks and events, set up playdates with other dogs from their class directory, and worked through some adolescent reactivity in private sessions with Kris. At every stage we have felt supported by the friendly and knowledgeable trainers and would wholeheartedly recommend Raintown in any and every capacity! Plus we regularly get compliments from other dog owners on our pup's recall, which is 100% thanks to the "emergency recall" lesson in Basic Manners class.

My vet suggested Kris for puppy training and I am very happy with the results after two private sessions.  A family friend and I have Shih Tzu puppies from the same litter and we were concerned with their play fight ,which looked rough at times.
Having Kris present during their play fighting and her knowledge of dog body language gave us the reassurance and confidence to know that the play was healthy (thankfully!).  Kris also showed us how to recognize if it was not and what to do to give them a break.

Kris also taught Mila and I two easy techniques that we learned in minutes.  We use them every day during our walks, when Mila is distracted and I need to get her attention back to me, or at home to stop her barking at noises in the hallway.  These techniques can be used for so many things and Mila loves it too because she gets lots of treats! 😊

Kris also provided access to notes on our sessions,  video, and articles to reference too.

A big thank you Kris from Mila and I.  We look forward to joining group sessions in the future!

Grady had such a wonderful time with the other puppies and we certainly benefited from the lessons and socialization exercises. The Raintown team is excellent at leading and facilitating a fun series of classes.

BEST place for your puppy’s training in Vancouver! We and our pup absolutely LOVE Sara and Dana and the community they (and the rest of the team) have built! Such kind, caring and passionate trainers! Highly recommend them! ❤️

Our 5 month old puppy has been growing in confidence thanks to the small group training and socialization drop in classes. All the trainers have been so wonderful and we are happy to recommend Raintown for any owners looking for a well managed place where their dog can practice their skills!
Great facility and lovely trainers. Would highly recommend to any family with a new puppy.
Socials and classes are fabulous. Instructors are so committed, genuine and generous, as well as very effective!

As first-time puppy owners, we wanted to work with force-free trainers who used positive re-enforcement to help us strengthen our bond with our new family member. Raintown is a delight, making learning fun for us as responsible pet owners and rewarding for our puppy. There's also lots of love about owner Kris and a huge shoutout to her wonderful team, who just radiate sunshine and PAWsitivity. Their science-based approach gives us confidence in knowing that we're setting our fur baby up for life-long success. Thank you, Raintown Dogs!

Raintown is simply the best. We have done Basic Manners 1 and 2 and would happily do a third if available. My only regret is that we would liked to have get our fluf puff in there for some of the puppy classes. You can't go wrong with Raintown.

Highly recommend Raintown! My dog Bailey and I attended a 5 week training course. I learned just as much as Bailey on how to care and train him properly. The trainers are so nice and supportive. I highly recommend this place for doggy training!

An amazing group of talented young women.  The programmes are very well structured, yet adaptable for each individual puppy.  Classes are small enough that everybody gets individual attention.  The entire team are highly professional trainers (with a generous dose of common sense mixed in)- who ensure that the time that Owners spend with them is enjoyable and productive.  I wouldn't hesitate to recommend any of the Raintown courses.

My partner and I did two private training sessions with Kris to help my Shiba Marcy with her leash reactivity. She had had several incidents prior to our sessions where she had bitten my partner and I due to her reactivity and we decided we needed some extra help.

The two sessions were really great for getting feedback on how we could help her and proceed with desensitization training. A year and a half out we’ve been very consistent with positive reinforcement and desensitization training and she has improved a lot. She’s not perfect but the most important thing to me is that there hasn’t been a biting incident since before our sessions with Kris since we are now able to recognize Marcy’s body language. Doing training while on daily walks with her has been such a joy and has really made our bond closer.

Highly recommend Raintown and Kris! And thank you from Marcy and I.

Juniper 🐾 and I love raintown! The classes have given me so much confidence as a pup parent, and all the staff truly care about all the dogs. We're enjoying the care and community even after the classes are done! …

Although we'd owned dogs before and thought we had a decent idea of what we were doing, we learned so much from the lovely people at Raintown. They had such a great understanding of our puppy's needs as well as ours without being preachy or patronising. We looked forward to classes as both us and our pup had lots of fun!

Can't find a better dog training facility than Raintown...my puppy LOVESSSSS going to the puppy kindergarten and socials classes...Bern and Rhi are my absolute fav trainers there...they're super knowledgeable and gives me so much inspiration to train my puppy and work harder to train my puppy after each class, l highly recommend this place for anyone looking to train their puppy or enroll them in socials classes, which is just as important for puppies!

I cant say enough good things about the trainers at Raintown 🥰

I started puppy kindergarten here when my Frenchton Sam was 11 weeks old, and it was such an incredible experience, I learned so much about how to increase the behaviours I want and decrease the ones I don’t, as well as had lots of opportunities to let Sam learn how to socialize with other dogs.

I get compliments on how friendly and well behaved she is basically everytime I step out with her, and I gotta say I really think a lot of that has to do with that early socialization. She is so good with people and basically all dogs, even shy ones. Both of us gained a ton of confidence.

I’m now back for the advanced manners and learning so much more! This class would have been worth it for the emergency recall training alone, but the work with calm greetings, and some other more quality-of-life training like go to mat, has been great too.

Anyway, if you’ve got a new puppy or someone a lil older who you wanna do some manners work, I can’t recommend this place highly enough.

We really enjoyed training at Raintown including puppy socials, basic manners and a 1:1 session. The trainers are so patient and understanding, truly trying to equip you with the skills to set up your pup for success. Timber continues to have great recall and emergency recall when needed - a simple yet invaluable skill that helps in our day to day and gives us peace of mind when out and about. Thanks Raintown team!
Thank you so much, Alison, for your review! :)

As a pet store owner in Vancouver, I’m always on the lookout for trusted trainers to refer my clients to and Raintown Dog Training is hands down one of the best. So many of our customers have taken their dogs here and I’ve seen firsthand the amazing results. The owner and staff are incredibly knowledgeable, kind, and genuinely care about every dog that walks through their doors. Whether it’s puppy training or more advanced behavioural work, they approach everything with patience and professionalism. I’m so grateful to have such a reputable training facility in our community! Highly recommend.

Kris has been working with our puppy Bernie and I can’t speak highly enough of her skills and professionalism. We have made huge progress in his behaviour and social skills, which is undoubtedly down to Raintown dog training. Highly recommend 🙌 …

Having observed some classes several months ago, I was hugley impressed, not only, with the way the staff worked with dogs, but also with the clients!
This being the case, I'm interested to know why, having had overwhelmingly positive reviews for several years, suddenly there have been several 1-star reviews, none of which have comments, and according to the owners, there is no record of the reviewers having attended the courses on offer.
This looks very much like an orchestrated attack, for whatever reasons, on what is clearly an outstanding enterprise. All I can say is shame on the perpetrators. I hope Google will look into this. In the meantime, can I encourage all dog lovers to show their support and, if you haven't already signed up for a class, please do so!

From puppy pre-k, to kindergarten and finally basic manners, my family and I have gathered so much useful information from our time spent with the Raintown team. We have learned the value of foundational commands, and were further taught on how we could apply theories of both classical and operant conditioning into real world situations. Sara and Dana have been so helpful in answering all of our questions and concerns about separation anxiety, crate training and managing signs of resource guarding. I can’t recommend these classes enough!! They have provided us with the skills needed to support and care for dogs for a lifetime. The most valuable thing I’ve learned during my time here is to never underestimate the importance of high value treats!!!! Very grateful for the Raintown team and all of their hard work 🐾

Had such a great experience with Raintown! Everyone is so well educated and truly helped us out so much with our new puppy. If you're looking for a dog trainer in the lower mainland, I 100% recommend seeing the girls at Raintown !

The Raintown team is amazing.  They are great and bringing both the puppies and the pawrents into the learning, providing fun and practical exercises, and have all of us leave each session more comfortable and confident to head out into the world.

If you have or are expecting a puppy in Vancouver, you must add these classes to your to-do list. This became our puppy, MJ’s happiest night of the week! He not only socialized with other puppies in a safe and controlled environment, he learned and trained alongside them calmly (learned he does not always need to interact). We also learned how to keep him and other dogs safe and comfortable when playing together.

We learned so many helpful tips on the mechanics of training which we’ve seen make huge differences in how well he learns at home. Both MJ and us as owners are happier and more confident. This is a safe space to bring your questions and puppy-specific training concerns.

We will be attending more socials and classes as our puppy grows up. Thank you to Kris, Dana, and all other trainers at Raintown! ❤️

Let me count the ways Saber and I love Raintown. We started with puppy socials when he was just 9 weeks old and it was a game changer - helping him learn bite inhibition, how to interact with other doggies and with the added bonus of completing exhausting his little mind and body for about 24 hours!!

Then we did Puppy Kindergarten and both learned a ton, followed by Basic Manners (level 1). The team are so open and caring and helpful and knowledgeable - in person they'll answer any questions before, during and after class, and apparently you can send them endless emails and still get a thoughtful, kind and helpful response. :)

Honestly can't say enough about how great they are. Thank you all!!

Thank you for your feedback, Talia. We take all reviews seriously, but we’re unable to find any record of your visit to our business. We’d appreciate the opportunity to understand more about your experience—if you believe this review was left in error or if there’s been a misunderstanding, please feel free to reach out to us directly.  Our goal is always to provide a great experience, and we’re here to help if we can.
Kindly,
Kris

Raintown definitely deserves the 5 stars! We learned so much in puppy kindergarten and just started Basic manners class. Getting our first puppy with all the conflicting info online was a struggle but Bern answered all of our questions and gave us so many great tips and tricks. Go to Raintown if you want passionate and dedicated dog trainers!

Raintown classes and workshops are the absolute best. I’ve taken kindergarten class, manners class, emergency recall and social drop ins with both my dogs. Kris and Bernadette and all the team are super helpful, encouraging and welcoming. If you are looking for some excellent training that is also super fun for you and your dogo, sign up for a class with Raintown.  You and your dog will love it. ❤️

Our puppy attended puppy kindergarten, and also just completed the emergency recall workshop. The classes are so fun, we genuinely enjoyed attending them. All of the instructors are so kind, personable, and extremely knowledgeable. We’re so impressed with everything our puppy has learned and truly could not have done it without the Raintown team! They’re seriously the best.

We just finished the emergency recall workshop and it was great! I really appreciated the small class and how the lessons were well planned and detailed instructions were given.
Pic is our dog at the last class on the beach, and she did so well! 😊
Thank you so much Raintown Dog Training team.

We just finished the puppy kindergarten and it was a great experience. Bern was just the best trainer and helped us with all our endless questions. The training experience was filled with great tips and tricks and a lot of hands on experience. We could not have had a better experience! Thank you so much Bern and Raintown Dog training!
Best experience, thanks Raintown Dog Training. Xo

We have learned so much from our time with Raintown. The humans that lead this class are top notch in their expertise, and they are so good at explaining the practical and theoretical of puppy training. Our puppy has come a long way with their help! They are also a very inclusive company, welcoming families of all kinds, and they even pay special attention to younger humans participating in the class. Our sessions at Raintown are a highlight of our week as they are also so much fun. They have helped us feel confident in our puppy-raising. We look forward to taking more classes with them!

Bernadette was an incredible trainer for our dog Mango. In just two private sessions, mango came so far. We worked on getting her to settle with guests in her home and she’s improved tremendously. Thank you Bernadette for all your help.

We have used Raintown for puppy training and socialization. The trainers are all fantastic: very knowledgeable, friendly and great at explaining dog behaviour and body language. Our puppy has become a well behaved dog and we have become confident owners. Highly recommend.

We took the Basic Manners Class with Raintown Dog Training and loved it! Sara & Dana did an amazing job and Vader learned and us learned a lot. I highly recommend Raintown and looking forward to the Second Basic Manners Class. Thank you very much for helping us learn and teaching Vader.

My husband and I enjoyed our experience at Raintown. We did the Basic Manners course with our dog Charlie. The sessions were very informative. Bern and Rhi had a  wealth of experience and knowledge to share with us. Class size was limited to 6 families. We focused on a particular behaviour/skill each class that we could practice at home.   Would definitely consider doing the next level of training in the spring at Raintown.
Our dog Pepper learnt so much at Raintown! We’ll be back for more classes and would really recommend Bern and Rhi. Cheers!

We completed the puppy kindergarten (lead by Sara & Dana) and it was fantastic! They're both great instructors. There was a lot of lessons, tips and tricks delivered with a sensible progression over the 5 weeks. It's called puppy training, but it's really owner training and we received a lot of great direction throughout. We’ve been working with Raintown Dog Training for about six months, and we can’t recommend this team enough for new puppy owners. We've completed Puppy Kindergarten, one-on-one walking classes, and Basic Manners 1, and without their guidance and support, we would have been completely lost. Penny has made incredible progress, especially with loose leash walking—thank you, Bern!

One of the biggest challenges we faced was calming Penny’s social nature. She was always so excited to meet new dogs, which made loose leash walking difficult. Raintown’s approach of structured, positive reinforcement training has worked wonders. They taught us how to manage her excitement and create a calm, focused walking routine. Now, walks are enjoyable for both of us, and Penny is much more controlled in social situations. Though we are still working on squirrels :)

The team at Raintown are highly skilled, regulated trainers with a wealth of knowledge and experience. They genuinely care about both the pups and their humans, creating a supportive learning environment. The safe socialization exercises have helped Penny and us learn the doggy signs and cues, we've seen such positive changes in her behaviour.

Thank you, Raintown team, for your support and for giving us the tools to help Penny thrive!
Knowledgeable, practical, inclusive (of both dogs and people) and fun. This place is excellent for new dog owners and a great resource for the community.

THANK YOU Raintown, can not thank you all enough.

We found Raintown Dog Training through Instagram when a friend posted that they'd had some success with managing their rescue dog's reactivity. We booked a package of sessions with Rhiannon, and are now very pleased that our reactive rescue dog has responded extremely well to the training.

Rhiannon is detail oriented, an excellent listener, and she took a methodical and creative approach to help Kit respond differently to her triggers, including one session where we practiced engaging and disengaging with a friend and her dog. She's knowledgeable, patient, and gave us some great advice on how to manage Kit when she becomes too overstimulated to disengage from her triggers.

After every session she sent us a thorough summary outlining what we worked on, what we can practice, and further resources/info. She was lovely to work with, Kit loves her, and we're very happy with the results.  We'll definitely reach out again if we need any more training.
Thank you so much!
